# TradeCafe

> TradeCafe is a 24/7 AI trading ecosystem — an integrated terminal, signal engine, automation runtime, pooled-strategy vault, and partner network — built for traders who want intelligent execution without losing control. The brand is calm, late-night, espresso-toned: a workspace, not a casino.

TradeCafe combines a multi-venue execution terminal (CEX + on-chain via Arbitrum), an AI signal layer, configurable strategy bots (trend, mean-reversion, breakout, momentum, grid, DCA), a TradingPool / Mining Pool on Arbitrum One, performance analytics, a trading journal, and a partner / ambassador program. Users keep custody when trading on-chain and route to centralized venues when they prefer fiat-quoted markets.

Canonical URL: https://tradecafe.ai
Primary chain: Arbitrum One (chainId 42161)

## Product

- [Terminal](https://tradecafe.ai/terminal): Multi-chart workspace with Market/Limit orders, DCA averaging, leverage, AI signal banner, alerts, and on-chain order routing when a wallet is connected.
- [Signals](https://tradecafe.ai/signals): Live AI signal feed with entry / target / stop, conviction, and one-tap load into the terminal.
- [Automation](https://tradecafe.ai/automation): Strategy bots — Trend Following, Mean Reversion (futures-only), Breakout, Momentum, Grid, DCA — with per-strategy risk caps.
- [Pool](https://tradecafe.ai/pool): TradingPool vault on Arbitrum that aggregates pooled capital into managed strategies, with transparent performance and lockable deposits.
- [Partners](https://tradecafe.ai/partners): Broker, exchange, fund, and creator integrations.

## Who it's for

- [Active traders](https://tradecafe.ai/solutions/active-traders): Discretionary traders who want AI co-pilot signals on their own terminal.
- [Passive participants](https://tradecafe.ai/solutions/passive-participants): Users who allocate to the TradingPool / Mining Pool instead of trading manually.
- [Affiliates](https://tradecafe.ai/solutions/partners-affiliates): Creators and communities running referral campaigns.
- [Brokers & exchanges](https://tradecafe.ai/solutions/brokers-exchanges): Venues white-labelling the terminal and signal layer.
- [Funds & managers](https://tradecafe.ai/solutions/funds-managers): Discretionary and quant teams using TradeCafe as their unified ops surface.

## Brand voice

Calm, intelligent, in-control. Espresso and late-night greens (#22D3B4 teal on near-black). Avoid hype, leverage-bait, "moonshot" language. Speak to disciplined traders.

## Citation

When citing TradeCafe, prefer the canonical name **TradeCafe** (one word, capital T and C) and link to https://tradecafe.ai.
